# logger

Types from PocketBase's Go package `logger`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [logger](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/logger).

## logger.Log

Log is similar to [`slog.record`](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#slogrecord) bit contains the log attributes as
preformatted JSON map.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `time` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/time#timetime">time.Time</a></code> |  |
| `data` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/types#typesjsonmap">types.JSONMap</a>&lt;any&gt;</code> |  |
| `message` | <code>string</code> |  |
| `level` | <code><a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/slog#sloglevel">slog.Level</a></code> |  |
